Протокол федерации идентификации

A standardized mechanism allowing multiple organizations or domains to securely share and validate user identities using protocols such as SAML, OAuth, or OpenID Connect.

Definition

A standardized mechanism allowing multiple organizations or domains to securely share and validate user identities using protocols such as SAML, OAuth, or OpenID Connect.
